rawRetro.summary: Repair-4 fixed the 150 ESLint errors that failed the lint stage on the server service layer, the three TypeScript errors the following typecheck stage would have hit, and a set of runtime defects the later build/database/start stages would have hit: ServiceDomainProvider was never registered, it failed in runtimes without the business schema or the auth tokens, date-field filters used equality instead of the `on` operator, the composite action `runTask` had no grant, and a router-wide `use('*')` turned every unknown `/api` path into a 401 instead of a 404. Format, lint, all three typechecks, the full 245-test suite, the production build, `db apply`, a production boot with schema provisioning, and a live HTTP smoke (401 on owned service paths, 404 on unknown paths) now pass. The client feature pages, database seeds and request-level business tests are still absent from the workspace.

blockers.title: The business application still lacks its client surface and business seeds/tests
blockers.symptom: The workspace now contains the server service layer (server/service/service.ts, providers, routes, migrations), but database/main/seeds/ is empty, client/routes.ts still registers only the template home and auth pages, client/pages has no business pages, and tests/ has no request-level business tests. The seeded sample service accounts also cannot use any business endpoint: each account in SAMPLE_ACCOUNTS declares a `permissionSet`, but the provider never assigns it, so a signed-in sample user gets 403 PERMISSION_DENIED (`No grant allows service.*`) from every service route.
blockers.rootCause: The implementation run exhausted its context while writing server/service/service.ts (agent-implement.jsonl ended with stopReason 'length' and a failed overflow compaction) and stopped before completing the seeds and client. Later repair rounds worked on the server side and never restored the missing client.
blockers.resolution: Not resolved in this repair round: the repair scope was the reported lint/type failures and the server-side fixes. The missing client pages, seeds and tests must be implemented before the business requirements can be assessed end-to-end. The sample-account permission-set assignment and any production seeds for the initial jobs remain to be implemented (using `authz.permissionSets.assign(...)`), together with the client pages and tests.

issues.title: Prettier format:check failed on server/service/resources.ts
issues.symptom: `pnpm format:check` reported server/service/resources.ts as having code style issues and exited 1, failing the verification run.
issues.rootCause: Chained authorization builder calls in server/service/resources.ts (the deviceData, manualData and reports view grants) were wrapped across extra lines in a style Prettier does not produce, so the file was not Prettier-clean.
issues.resolution: Ran Prettier on server/service/resources.ts (formatting-only change: collapsed the chained `.title().grant()` call chains). Confirmed `prettier server/service --check` and the factory's `prettier . --check '!.github/**'` both pass.

issues.title: ESLint failed on server/service/resources.ts
issues.symptom: `pnpm lint` reported three errors in server/service/resources.ts: two `@typescript-eslint/no-redundant-type-constituents` on the `workOrderReadFields`/`deviceReadFields` `satisfies` clauses and one `@typescript-eslint/no-unnecessary-type-assertion` on `idsScope('id', ids) as FilterNode`.
issues.rootCause: `keyof WorkOrder & string` and `keyof Device & string` were redundant intersections because those key types are already strings, and `as FilterNode` asserted a type `idsScope` already returns.
issues.resolution: Dropped `& string` from both `satisfies readonly (keyof ...)[]` clauses and removed the redundant `as FilterNode` assertion. `pnpm exec eslint server/service --max-warnings 0` passes.

issues.title: TypeScript errors would have failed the next verify stage
issues.symptom: `tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit` reported TS2307 in server/service/tokens.ts (cannot find module './service.js') and TS7008 in server/service/views.ts (member 'readonly' implicitly has an 'any' type).
issues.rootCause: tokens.ts imported `ServiceDomain` from server/service/service.ts, which the implementation run never finished writing; views.ts had a stray `readonly;` modifier line placed before the `created` field of `ExternalTicketAcceptedView`.
issues.resolution: Removed the dangling import and created the service token without a type parameter (nothing consumes the token yet), and replaced the stray `readonly;` with the JSDoc comment attached to `created`. `tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit` passes.

issues.title: ESLint failed with 150 errors on the repair-3 server service layer
issues.symptom: `pnpm lint` reported 150 errors: repository filter callbacks and item arrays typed `any` (server/service/service.ts), `no-base-to-string` on `unknown` DB columns, several unnecessary type assertions, a useless `createdCount` initializer, an unused scheduler module import, an untyped service token making `container.resolve()` `unknown` in server/providers/service.ts, and a pino logger call with metadata in the message-first position. The server typecheck also hid three further errors (createOne values type, pino `warn` signature, Kysely count `select`) because lint runs first.
issues.rootCause: The repair-3 code used `(f: any)` for every Repository filter builder and `any[]` for filter item arrays, stringified `unknown` columns with `String(...)`, called `createServiceToken` without its `Service` type argument (so every `container.resolve(serviceToken)` returned `unknown`), passed pino metadata as the second argument, selected an aggregate with a callback returning a single `AliasedExpression` instead of a `SelectionExpression[]`, and typed a seed row with an index signature that was not assignable to the repository mutation input.
issues.resolution: Typed the six filter callbacks with `FilterBuilder<T>` and their item arrays with `FilterNode[]`; added a scalar-only `fileText` helper and restricted `iso`/`String` to primitives; typed the token as `createServiceToken<Service>('app/service')` and removed the now-redundant route cast; removed the unused scheduler module import and the unnecessary assertions; moved the logger error object before the message; selected the count as `(builder) => [builder.fn.countAll().as('count')]`; and made the seed record type `{ id: string }`. `eslint . --max-warnings 0`, `prettier . --check`, and `tsc` (client, node and server projects) all pass.

issues.title: Five runtime defects would have failed the database, build, start and smoke stages after lint
issues.symptom: After lint and typecheck were fixed: (1) `server/providers/index.ts` exported an empty array, so `serviceToken` was never bound before `registerRoutes()` resolved it and the service routes could not be created; (2) `ServiceDomainProvider.boot()`/`start()` assumed the authorization and user-administration tokens and fully migrated tables, so embedded-server tests and partial runtimes failed to start; (3) `completeTodayInspection` and two `runDailyInspections` filters compared a `date` column with `{ planDate: value }` / `f.string('planDate').eq(...)`, which the filter builder rejects for date fields; (4) `systemResource.runTask` had no grants, so composite validation threw `Composite resource action runTask grants nothing`; (5) `server/routes/service.ts` installed `router.use('*', authentication.required())` and `router.use('*', authorization.middleware())`, and because the app merges every API contribution into one `/api` router, the wildcard also matched sibling paths: `GET /api/articles` returned 401 instead of the expected 404 ROUTE_NOT_FOUND (the `starts a fresh Default without example tables or APIs` test).
issues.rootCause: The repair-3 server rewrite left the provider unregistered and its lifecycle unconditional; the filter callbacks used scalar equality on `date` fields instead of the dedicated date operator; the new `runTask` system action was declared without a permission grant; and the route file used a global `use('*')` instead of scoping its middleware to the paths it owns.
issues.resolution: Registered `ServiceDomainProvider` in `server/providers/index.ts`; guarded `boot()` on `authorizationToken` and `start()` on `userAdministrationServiceToken`, `authorizationToken` and a `hasServiceSchema()` check so partial runtimes start cleanly; changed the three date filters to `f.date('planDate').on(...)` combined with `f.and([...])`; added a `scheduledRunManage` permission on `scheduledRuns` and granted it to `systemResource.runTask`; and replaced the global middleware with per-prefix `router.use(prefix, ...)` plus `router.use(prefix + '/*', ...)` over the twelve owned top-level segments, so unknown `/api/*` paths keep the router's 404 and owned paths still run authentication and authorization. Verified the full 245-test suite, the production build, `db apply`, a production boot (health 200, sample data provisioned) and live HTTP behavior (401 on `/api/customers`, 404 on `/api/articles`).

B08. 用受控 Scheduler 执行生成到期设备巡检和超期提醒，重复执行不重复生成同日结果，未到期/停用设备及已关闭工单不被处理；计划启停保存正确，停用后的受控调度机会不再产生新结果。负责人完成巡检并刷新核对。

B10. 通过既有管理入口创建并撤销集成用户密钥；独立 HTTP 测试验证报修、状态查询、重复事件去重和禁止处理/关闭，撤销或停用后调用失败。密钥全程去敏。

B11. 主管上传两份手册，页面显示真实处理状态，普通工程师不能修改库内容。条件可用时，助手能回答一条有依据问题并提供引用，对资料外问题说明不足，对无权工单拒绝泄漏；更新手册后新对话依据新内容。缺外部条件时分别报告接入完成度与真实检索/回答未验证。

retro.summary: Repair-4 fixed the 150 ESLint errors that failed the lint stage on the server service layer, the three TypeScript errors the following typecheck stage would have hit, and a set of runtime defects the later build/database/start stages would have hit: ServiceDomainProvider was never registered, it failed in runtimes without the business schema or the auth tokens, date-field filters used equality instead of the `on` operator, the composite action `runTask` had no grant, and a router-wide `use('*')` turned every unknown `/api` path into a 401 instead of a 404. Format, lint, all three typechecks, the full 245-test suite, the production build, `db apply`, a production boot with schema provisioning, and a live HTTP smoke (401 on owned service paths, 404 on unknown paths) now pass. The client feature pages, database seeds and request-level business tests are still absent from the workspace.

blockers.title: The business application still lacks its client surface and business seeds/tests
blockers.symptom: The workspace now contains the server service layer (server/service/service.ts, providers, routes, migrations), but database/main/seeds/ is empty, client/routes.ts still registers only the template home and auth pages, client/pages has no business pages, and tests/ has no request-level business tests. The seeded sample service accounts also cannot use any business endpoint: each account in SAMPLE_ACCOUNTS declares a `permissionSet`, but the provider never assigns it, so a signed-in sample user gets 403 PERMISSION_DENIED (`No grant allows service.*`) from every service route.
blockers.rootCause: The implementation run exhausted its context while writing server/service/service.ts (agent-implement.jsonl ended with stopReason 'length' and a failed overflow compaction) and stopped before completing the seeds and client. Later repair rounds worked on the server side and never restored the missing client.
blockers.resolution: Not resolved in this repair round: the repair scope was the reported lint/type failures and the server-side fixes. The missing client pages, seeds and tests must be implemented before the business requirements can be assessed end-to-end. The sample-account permission-set assignment and any production seeds for the initial jobs remain to be implemented (using `authz.permissionSets.assign(...)`), together with the client pages and tests.
